assumptions: Compustat rows use INDL/C/D/STD selectors; the article does not state current-vintage row selectors.
Average assets use adjacent fiscal-year AT balances; the article does not state averaging endpoints.
Compustat Funda SICH is preferred; date-valid CRSP DSENAMES SICCD is used only where SICH is unavailable. Valid current/past/future currency codes must agree because no conversion is inferred.
CRSP availability requires one valid LC/LU, P/C CCM link with a complete 12-month daily window starting four months after fiscal year-end, including the article's documented delisting treatment.
The return period uses an exact-day half-open window: start=intnx(month,DATADATE,4,same), end=intnx(month,start,12,same); the paper does not specify first-of-month boundaries.

limitations: The paper leaves annual row selectors, average-assets endpoints, SIC source/date convention, and CCM link/security-selection rules unspecified; see design.md.

The 108,617 published firm-years are a comparison target, not an enforced count; the inherited current-vintage sample has 127,722 firm-years, and diagnostics do not attribute the difference to one cause.

Historical SIC sources disagree on 54,853 of 71,034 final rows with both codes valid: 34,147 share a two-digit SIC and 20,706 differ at two digits. Among these rows, 1,118 fall on opposite sides of the financial-company exclusion under FUNDA versus CRSP SIC; the paper gives no source-preference rule.
The published Table 4 descriptive-statistics transformation is not stated; review.md compares it with final ±1-winsorized local inputs.
